column3: “their descendants after them” renders “his offspring after him”; “personally” renders “by His presence (face).”
“unintentionally” renders “without knowledge”; “in time past” renders “from yesterday and the third day.”
“the plateau” renders “the land of the plain.”
“the valley of Arnon” renders “the wadi of Arnon”; NASB adds parentheses around “that is, Hermon.”
